output.review_comment:
The fix treats the [1, 2) range specially: those values are always rounded up, and every other value rounds half-up. This has no principled basis and looks like it was added just to make a specific test pass. It gives inconsistent output: 1034 B (≈1.0098 KB) shows as "1.1 KB", but 2058 B (≈2.0098 KB) shows as "2.0 KB". A rounding rule shouldn't depend on which whole number the value is near.

Please find the one rounding rule the spec/tests actually encode (e.g. always ceil to 1 decimal for quota display, or round half-up) and apply it to every value. If no single rule satisfies all the tests, raise that with the teammate instead of special-casing a range.

Also add a PR description saying which test(s) were failing and what spec the new rounding implements, including the behaviour change from float formatting to Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP. The 1024.0 → next-unit rollover is reasonable, but it should have a test covering it.
